disclosure: Wrapper layer measured on Gate.io spot v4 (public, keyless) at 2026-09-23T10:51:11.555Z: 33 tokenised-equity wrappers verified against 33 of 71 library instruments (46.5% coverage), each after a price test against the underlying's raw session close and a daily-return correlation test. Median return correlation 0.9561, median tracking error 47 bp/day, median premium 0.08%, median spread 33.13 bp. The 7x24 part, measured: the reference cash market is closed for 81.4% of the week (136.67h of 168h), and across the verified wrappers a median 60.9% of the wrapper's own realised hourly price movement happened while it was closed. This is a measurement of the instrument layer, not a new price source: no retrieval, conformal or validation figure in AnalogDesk uses it. Snapshots change every second; what is reported is the state at generatedAt.
